project: Wuxia Life P84 Medical Sage Entry Differentiation Refinement
description: Add post-bridge entry differentiation refinement for medical_sage_healer route — deepen compassionate vs pragmatic variants, add sample-line entry expression, provide GO/NO-GO for full spine implementation. Bounded scope following P72 renown entry differentiation pattern.

userStories.title: Audit post-bridge entry sharedness & variant gap
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of what the medical route currently shares at post-bridge entry and how the two variants differ so P84 targets the real flattening points.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the currently shared gates, markers, and expression at the post-bridge entry layer
Analyze current differentiation strength between compassionate and pragmatic variants
Separate healthy reuse from flattening that weakens player-perceived route identity
Save docs/test-reports/p84-medical-entry-sharedness-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story
userStories.notes: Foundational audit — must complete before implementation begins.

userStories.title: Lock P84 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P84 stays an entry-differentiation refinement stage and does not sprawl into deeper route densification.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P84 to early post-bridge and entry-adjacent differentiation only
Define allowed layers: light configuration, expression, proof, and narrow tests
List forbidden expansions: on-ramp/pressure/payoff waves, new systems, and full route expansion
Define boundary with P85 (on-ramp spine)
Save docs/test-reports/p84-medical-entry-scope-contract.md
userStories.notes: Scope guardrails for the entry differentiation refinement stage.

userStories.title: Define medical entry differentiation contract
userStories.description: As a designer, I want an explicit entry contract so the medical route's bridge identity and two variant flavors survive contact with the shared destination path.
acceptanceCriteria: Define the core identity signals that must be preserved at entry for the tavern-born healer route
Define entry-level differentiation contract between compassionate and pragmatic variants
State which differences belong in expression and which belong in light markers
Keep the shared destination skeleton intact
Record the contract in the PRD or an appendix artifact
userStories.notes: Entry differentiation contract — tavern-born healer identity + 2 variant flavors.

userStories.title: Wire entry-level differentiation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the medical route's post-bridge entry to expose bounded differentiation through existing carriers rather than a new framework.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the entry differentiation only through existing carriers, markers, or gate-adjacent wiring
Do not introduce a new route framework
Existing P83 bridge evidence does not regress
Both variants have distinct entry markers
Medical route is detectable by sample-line detection
userStories.notes: Core wiring — entry markers + sample-line detection + variant markers.

userStories.title: Add player-facing entry expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the medical route to read differently immediately after crossing the bridge so the new path keeps its identity at the first shared layer.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least 3 entry-specific readable signals across existing expression surfaces
Compassionate and pragmatic have perceptible expression differences at entry
Tavern-born healer flavor is recognizable in medical entry expression
No new UI components added
Add or update focused expression tests
userStories.notes: Player-visible identity — 3+ entry signals × 2 variants minimum.

userStories.title: Add targeted entry proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the medical route remains distinguishable at entry and the two variants feel meaningfully different.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one comparison-style targeted proof artifact
Show differences across: plain tavern, merchant bridge, renown bridge, medical bridge (compassionate), medical bridge (pragmatic)
Show entry markers or expression differences for the medical route vs other routes
Do not require full lifetime exhaust
Ensure the proof directly supports whether deeper differentiation / full spine is worth opening
userStories.notes: Comparison-style proof — 5 cases × multiple expression surfaces.

userStories.title: Add narrow regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the new entry differentiation so later edits do not flatten the route back into a generic shared entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Add test file tests/p84TavernHandMedicalEntryDifferentiationTests.ts
Cover entry markers, player-facing expression, and comparison-level assertions with narrow checks
Cover 2 variant differentiation assertions
Reuse existing harnesses
Do not rewrite the full test suite
Relevant commands pass: typecheck + related regression suites
userStories.notes: Narrow regression + existing suites must pass. Similar to P72 but with 2-variant focus.

userStories.title: Produce P84 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what entry differentiation now exists and whether deeper on-ramp/pressure/payoff spine work is justified.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p84-medical-sage-entry-differentiation-closure-report.md
Summarize the sharedness audit, contract, wiring, expression, proof, and tests
State whether full spine implementation (P85+) is worth opening later
List larger route-expansion items that remain deferred
Give route planning recommendations after on-ramp (pressure / payoff / late-life etc.)
userStories.notes: Closure and GO/NO-GO for P85+ on-ramp spine implementation.
